title: Get your Claude API key - Claude Platform Docs

observations.note: Raw page read 2026-10-04: 'Settings -> API keys' creates keys; step 4 states the Console shows the full key, which starts with sk-ant-, only once at creation; env example export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY with sk-ant-api03-... ; Admin API returns only a partially redacted hint and cannot recover a lost key. States no body length, alphabet or suffix.
